claims.disproof_condition: 條件：OPSB 或 Meta／Williams 的一手寫出 Socrates North 改接電網、用電方換人、或專案撤銷。核查頻率：每半年（OPSB 案號 25-188-EL-BGN 與 Williams 10-Q 的 Socrates 段）。觸發後 48 小時：降 e1 confidence，重讀 tech:onsite_gas_power 需求側。
claims.statement: Regulator's bulletin (Ohio Power Siting Board, 2025-09-18): OPSB approved the 200 MW natural gas fired Socrates North Power Generation Facility in New Albany, which will operate behind-the-meter to serve the electric load of an adjacent data center and will not be physically connected to the grid; Sidecat, an affiliate of Meta Platforms, Inc., will consume the power. Third-party (regulator) naming of the buyer. That Will-Power OH, LLC is Williams' project entity rests on Williams' own Socrates project page (not in this packet's graph quotes; see report).

sources.quote: The Ohio Power Siting Board (OPSB) approved the construction of a 200 megawatt (MW) natural gas fired electric generation facility in the city of New Albany and Licking County.
The Socrates North Power Generation Facility will operate “behind-the-meter” to serve the electric load of an adjacent data center and will not be physically connected to the electric power grid.
Will-Power OH, LLC will construct and operate the power plant on 20 acres within the New Albany International Business Park, and Sidecat, an affiliate of Meta Platforms, Inc., will consume the power.
